data.narrative:
Latitude is a Series B space and aerospace company that has raised €50M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 4 private companies at the same or adjacent stage—Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C)—alongside 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) with a median price-to-sales of 27.4x.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the €50M raised as a value proxy and applying a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $95M. Peer-median analysis anchors to the $1.6B median valuation across the four private comparables, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to lack of disclosed revenue data for the target.

Triangulation of the two applicable methods yields a valuation range of $81M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median implied value of $872M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around which peer cohort best represents Latitude's growth trajectory and market positioning within the fragmented space sector. Key sensitivities include near-term fundraising success, technology differentiation relative to the peer set, and sectoral funding conditions.
